# `aitbc exchange-island orderbook`

View the order book for a supported trading pair.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange-island orderbook [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--pair` | choice | — | yes | The Pair. |
| `--limit` | integer | `20` | no | Order book depth |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange-island orderbook --pair <pair>
```
